messages.author: e7cc390b005447b3
messages.subject: Segmentation fault
parts:
Hi! 

When I run a large model using INLA, I get a segmentation fault error. 
This is likely due to memory issues. How to avoid when buying more memory is not possible? Will pardiso solve it?

Function call: 

runINLA=inla(Y~f(spatial_group,model="generic0",Cmatrix=I2INLA,constr=T),data=KeepData,verbose=T,family="gaussian",control.fixed=prior.fixed,num.threads=1,control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb"),control.compute=list(smtp="band"))

Best
Fredrik

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Segmentation fault

see if this one helps. you may increase number of threads

,data=KeepData,verbose=T,family="gaussian",control.fixed=prior.fixed,num
.threads=1,control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb"),
inla.mode="experimental")

which I found by googling the forum.

Now it works! Great
